abstract: We examine how state policies requiring firms to facilitate workplace retirement saving affect household balance sheets. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP), we compare private-sector workers likely exposed to Oregon’s Automatic-Enrollment Individual Retirement Account (Auto-IRA) policy with similar workers in not-yet-adopting states. We find that the Auto-IRA policy is associated with increases in IRA and employer-sponsored retirement plan ownership and assets. We also find increases in checking or savings account ownership and balances, as well as higher credit card debt. The results suggest that Auto-IRA policies spill over to household liquidity management and borrowing.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了要求企业促进职场退休储蓄的州政策如何影响家庭资产负债表。利用收入与项目参与调查（SIPP）数据，我们将可能受俄勒冈州自动注册个人退休账户（Auto-IRA）政策影响的私营部门员工与尚未实施该政策的州的类似员工进行比较。研究发现，Auto-IRA政策与IRA及雇主资助退休计划的持有率及资产增加相关。同时，该政策还伴随着支票或储蓄账户持有率及余额的提升，以及信用卡债务的增加。结果表明，Auto-IRA政策会溢出至家庭流动性管理与借贷行为。
title: How Do State “Auto-IRA” Policies Affect Household Balance Sheets?
title_zh: 州“自动IRA”政策如何影响家庭资产负债表？

abstract: This study provides pre-registered, experimental evidence on the use of non-generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots to support students in large-enrollment undergraduate courses. We find the chatbot messaging increased students’ final grades and engagement with academic supports, such as tutoring. Treatment effects were generally consistent across student demographics, with the exception of treated women in a Microeconomics course, who earned final grades that were seven percentage points higher than women in the control group. This study provides evidence that integrating AI-enabled outreach and communication to students in their college courses can enhance student engagement, learning, and course performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于在大型本科课程中使用非生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人辅助学生的预注册实验证据。我们发现，聊天机器人信息提高了学生的期末成绩以及参与学术支持（如辅导）的积极性。处理效应在不同学生群体中总体一致，但微观经济学课程中接受干预的女性除外，其期末成绩比对照组女性高出七个百分点。本研究证明，将人工智能驱动的外联与沟通融入大学课程中，能够增强学生的参与度、学习效果及课程表现。
title: Let’s Chat: Leveraging Chatbot Outreach for Improved Course Performance
title_zh: 让我们聊聊：利用聊天机器人外联提升课程表现

abstract: This article investigates factor-augmented sparse MIDAS (Mixed Data Sampling) regressions for high-dimensional time series data, which may be observed at different frequencies. Our novel approach integrates sparse and dense dimensionality reduction techniques. We derive the convergence rate of our estimator under misspecification due to the MIDAS approximation error, τ-mixing dependence, and polynomial tails. Our method’s finite sample performance is assessed via Monte Carlo simulations. We apply the methodology to nowcasting U.S. GDP growth and demonstrate that it outperforms both sparse regression and standard factor-augmented regression during the COVID-19 pandemic. These findings indicate that the growth through this period was influenced by both idiosyncratic (sparse) and common (dense) shocks. The approach is implemented in the midasml R package, available on CRAN.
title: Factor-Augmented Sparse MIDAS Regressions with an Application to Nowcasting
title_zh: 因子增强的稀疏MIDAS回归及其在即时预测中的应用

abstract: Survey-based social science research increasingly depends on digital questionnaires, browserbased data collection, automated statistical workflows, and reproducible reports. Yet the integrity of the research objects that connect these stages remains weak in many projects. Questionnaire files, response datasets, analysis scripts, and reports are often stored as separate artefacts, and when any one of them is changed after fieldwork or after submission, reviewers and institutions may lack a simple way to verify whether the file is identical to the version used earlier. This paper proposes Social Science Research 6.0 as a proof-of-integrity framework for tamper-evident survey workflows. The framework uses SHA-256 hashing to assign verifiable digests to survey instruments, response datasets, analysis plans, scripts, and report outputs, and records them in a structured manifest that can be verified at any later point. The approach is demonstrated using surveyframe, an open-source R package that represents a questionnaire as a typed survey object, saves it as a hashed .sframe file, validates item and scale structure, reads response data, checks quality, scores scales, prepares analysis plans, and generates reproducible reports. A synthetic proof-of-concept confirms that the framework detects instrument modification, response tampering, and analysis-plan drift in all tested scenarios. The contribution is a low-cost, software-only method for improving trust, transparency, and auditability in digital social science research without requiring blockchain infrastructure or proprietary survey platforms.
abstract_zh: 基于问卷调查的社会科学研究日益依赖于数字化问卷、基于浏览器的数据收集、自动化统计工作流程以及可复现报告。然而，连接这些环节的研究对象完整性在许多项目中仍然薄弱。问卷文件、响应数据集、分析脚本和报告往往作为独立工件存储，当其中任何一个在实地调查后或提交后被修改时，审稿人和机构可能缺乏简单的方法来验证该文件是否与先前使用的版本一致。本文提出社会科学研究6.0（Social Science Research 6.0）作为防篡改调查工作流的完整性证明框架。该框架使用SHA-256哈希为调查工具、响应数据集、分析计划、脚本和报告输出分配可验证的摘要，并将其记录在结构化清单中，可在后续任何时间点进行验证。该方法通过surveyframe这一开源R包进行演示，该包将问卷表示为类型化的调查对象，保存为哈希化的.sframe文件，验证条目和量表结构，读取响应数据，检查质量，对量表进行评分，准备分析计划，并生成可复现报告。一项合成概念验证确认，该框架在所有测试场景中均能检测到工具修改、响应篡改和分析计划漂移。其贡献在于提供一种低成本、纯软件的方法，在不依赖区块链基础设施或专有调查平台的情况下，提升数字社会科学研究的可信度、透明度和可审计性。
title: Social Science Research 6.0: A Proof-of-Integrity Framework for Tamper-Evident Survey Instruments Using an Open-Source R Package
title_zh: 社会科学研究6.0：基于开源R包的可防篡改调查工具完整性证明框架

abstract: This paper examines the unintended consequences of the 2018–2019 US‐China trade war for Vietnam, a key bystander economy, using quarterly HS 8‐digit US import data from 2017Q1 to 2020Q4. While the average treatment effect on Vietnam's exports to the US is small and statistically insignificant, substantial heterogeneity arises from pre‐war revealed comparative advantages (RCAs). Vietnam experienced markedly stronger export growth in sectors where China held high pre‐war RCA, consistent with trade diversion and substitution effects. These gains were nonlinear and most pronounced in sectors where Vietnam initially had low comparative advantage, reflecting the exploitation of previously untapped export opportunities. Consequently, Vietnam captured meaningful trade‐diversion benefits primarily outside its pre‐existing areas of comparative strength. In addition, we provide consistent evidence that the relocation of MNCs is strongly associated with the observed export surge. By quantifying these spillovers, our study contributes to the literature on global value chain dynamics and trade protectionism.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2017年第一季度至2020年第四季度美国HS 8位数进口季度数据，考察了2018-2019年中美贸易战对关键旁观经济体越南的意外后果。尽管越南对美出口的平均处理效应较小且统计上不显著，但战前显性比较优势（RCA）的差异导致了显著的异质性。在中国战前RCA较高的行业中，越南出口增长明显更为强劲，这与贸易转移和替代效应一致。这些收益呈非线性特征，且在越南初始比较优势较低的行业中最为显著，反映了对先前未开发出口机会的利用。因此，越南主要在其既有比较优势领域之外获得了显著的贸易转移收益。此外，我们提供了一致证据表明，跨国公司的迁移与观察到的出口激增密切相关。通过量化这些溢出效应，本研究为全球价值链动态与贸易保护主义相关文献做出了贡献。

abstract: This paper examines the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency using data for Chinese commercial banks from 2008 to 2017. We first construct a bank FinTech index with the help of web crawler technology and the data mining theory. Then, we examine the effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency. The results show that the development of bank FinTech significantly reduces credit risk inefficiency. Further, we explore the indirect effects and find that bank FinTech increases non‐interest business and thus reduces credit risk inefficiency. Finally, we find that the beneficial effects of bank FinTech on credit risk inefficiency are weaker for listed banks and state‐owned banks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008—2017年中国商业银行数据，考察银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的影响。首先，借助网络爬虫技术和数据挖掘理论构建银行金融科技指数；其次，检验银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的作用。结果表明，银行金融科技的发展显著降低了信贷风险非效率。进一步探究间接效应发现，银行金融科技通过增加非利息业务从而降低信贷风险非效率。最后，研究发现银行金融科技对信贷风险非效率的积极效应在上市银行和国有银行中较弱。

abstract: This study investigates the impact of bank capital regulation on firms' export behaviour within a two‐country theoretical framework that explicitly incorporates the banking sector. We show that more stringent capital requirements discourage firms from exporting and reduce export scale by increasing financing costs through tighter lending conditions. Using a comprehensive dataset of listed firms in China, we find that higher bank capital adequacy ratios are associated with lower export propensity and export volumes, with effects particularly pronounced for firms more reliant on bank credit. We further explore the moderating roles of financial market development and monetary policy. The results indicate that more developed financial markets amplify the adverse effects of bank capital regulation on firms' export performance, whereas tighter monetary policy mitigates these effects. By integrating banking regulation, financial conditions, and firm‐level trade outcomes, this study contributes to the literature on banking and international trade and offers policy‐relevant insights for regulators seeking to balance financial stability with firms' international competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究在明确纳入银行部门的两国理论框架下，探讨了银行资本监管对企业出口行为的影响。研究表明，更严格的资本要求通过收紧贷款条件提高融资成本，从而抑制企业出口意愿并降低出口规模。基于中国上市公司综合数据集，我们发现银行资本充足率越高，企业出口倾向与出口量越低，且该效应在更依赖银行信贷的企业中尤为显著。我们进一步探究了金融市场发展与货币政策的调节作用：结果显示，更发达的金融市场会放大银行资本监管对企业出口绩效的负面效应，而紧缩性货币政策则能缓解该影响。通过整合银行监管、金融条件与企业层面贸易结果，本研究为银行业与国际贸易领域的文献做出贡献，并为寻求平衡金融稳定与企业国际竞争力的监管者提供政策启示。

abstract: This paper uses datasets on Chinese public firms to examine the impact of clan culture on firm export activities in China. We find that a one standard deviation increase in our clan culture measure leads to a 10.27% increase in the firm export intensity on average. Mechanism analysis shows that the role of clan culture in promoting export activities is due to the rapid information sharing among clan members. Moreover, these effects are more pronounced in regions predominantly inhabited by Han Chinese and those with low levels of marketization.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司数据集，考察宗族文化对企业出口活动的影响。研究发现，宗族文化强度每增加一个标准差，企业出口强度平均提升10.27%。机制分析表明，宗族文化促进出口活动的作用源于宗族成员间的快速信息共享。此外，这种效应在汉族人口占主导地位以及市场化程度较低的地区更为显著。

abstract: This study investigates whether South–South cooperation delivers tangible economic benefits by examining the impact of the BRICS Plus platform on the economic development of participating countries. Using national‐level panel data for 125 countries from 2009 to 2022 and applying a staggered Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we find that BRICS Plus participation is associated with an average annual GDP per capita growth rate increase of approximately 3.42% compared to non‐participating countries on the same continent. Mechanism analysis suggests that the positive effect is driven by enhanced foreign direct investment, improvements in trade balances, and expanded financing channels, with India and China playing leading roles through investment, and South Africa contributing through regional financing. Participation is also linked to improved governance and reductions in civil conflicts but shows no significant increase in aid inflows from other international organizations. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive economic effects are concentrated in Asian and African countries, among low‐ and lower‐middle‐income economies with higher agricultural shares, and in countries with stronger initial infrastructure. Overall, the results provide empirical support for the developmental potential of institutionalized South–South cooperation through platforms like BRICS Plus.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察金砖+平台对参与国经济发展的影响，探究南南合作是否带来切实的经济效益。基于2009至2022年间125个国家的跨国面板数据，采用交错双重差分法，我们发现：相较于同大洲的非参与国，金砖+参与国的年均人均GDP增长率约提高3.42%。机制分析表明，这一积极效应源于外国直接投资增长、贸易平衡改善及融资渠道拓宽——其中印度和中国通过投资发挥引领作用，南非则通过区域融资作出贡献。参与金砖+还与治理水平提升及国内冲突减少相关，但未显著增加其他国际组织的援助流入。异质性分析显示，积极经济效应集中于亚洲和非洲国家、农业占比较高的低收入及中低收入经济体，以及初始基础设施较完善的国家。总体而言，本研究为通过金砖+等平台实现制度化的南南合作的发展潜力提供了实证支持。

abstract: This paper evaluates two core export‐promotion tools: internationalization grants and matchmaking services provided by the Portuguese export promotion agency (AICEP). We merge administrative records with customs and firm data for 2012–2021. We employ an event‐study approach with firm and year fixed effects in a setup of staggered adoption of the programs. Internationalization grants increase treated firms' total exports by approximately 13%, while matchmaking services raise exports to France by approximately 32%. Effects are larger for micro and small firms (grants 18%; matchmaking 40%) and concentrated in traditional manufacturing sectors. Results also show that both export promotion programs are effective when supporting firms with a permanent presence in international markets, versus occasional exporters. Event‐study diagnostics show flat pre‐trends, and placebo and anticipation checks support identification. Complementarily, finite‐duration robustness tests show no rapid fadeout after 3 years, and a simple cost–benefit analysis indicates that both programs have favorable cost–benefit outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了两种核心出口促进工具：葡萄牙出口促进机构（AICEP）提供的国际化补贴和配对服务。我们整合了2012-2021年的行政记录、海关数据与企业数据。在项目分阶段推行的设定下，采用包含企业固定效应和年份固定效应的事件研究方法。国际化补贴使受处理企业的总出口额增加约13%，而配对服务使对法国的出口额增加约32%。对微型和小型企业的影响更大（补贴效应18%；配对效应40%），且集中于传统制造业部门。研究结果还表明，当支持企业在国际市场保持长期存在时，两种出口促进工具均比支持偶发性出口商更为有效。事件研究诊断显示预处理期趋势平稳，安慰剂检验和预期效应检验支持识别有效性。此外，有限期稳健性检验表明，三年后效应未快速衰减，简单的成本收益分析显示两种项目均具有有利的成本收益结果。
title: Export Promotion With Matchmaking and Grants: Evidence From Portuguese Firms
title_zh: 匹配与资助型出口促进：来自葡萄牙企业的证据

abstract: This paper investigates whether and how U.S. exporters circumvent China's anti‐dumping (AD) measures by re‐routing trade through third countries. Using detailed data on AD cases and monthly trade flows of China and U.S. from 2002 to 2011, we apply a triple‐differences (DDD) approach to identify abnormal trade‐flow adjustments consistent with third‐country re‐routing. We find evidence of such patterns in a subset of cases following final AD rulings. Product characteristics, such as lower differentiation, higher financial leverage, and greater inventory pressure, are associated with variation in the feasibility and intensity of circumvention. Moreover, circumvention tends to occur through countries that are institutionally closer to the U.S. and geographically concentrated in Asia‐Oceania routes. The possible circumvention emerges after final rulings rather than during investigations.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国出口商是否以及如何通过第三国转运来规避中国的反倾销措施。基于2002年至2011年间中国与美国的反倾销案例详细数据及月度贸易流量，我们采用三重差分法识别与第三国转运模式相符的异常贸易流量调整。研究发现，在最终反倾销裁决后的部分案例中存在此类模式。产品特征（如差异化程度较低、财务杠杆较高及库存压力较大）与规避行为的可行性和强度差异相关。此外，规避行为往往通过与美国制度距离较近且地理上集中于亚洲-大洋洲路线的国家发生。可能的规避行为出现在最终裁决之后，而非调查期间。

abstract: The recent surge in outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) from developing countries has sparked concerns that inadequate environmental regulations in these nations could result in adverse environmental impacts on host countries through such investments. Focusing on the typical representative of developing countries' OFDI, this study explores the impact of China's greenfield investment on green total factor productivity (GTFP) in host countries, and analyzes the moderating effect of environmental regulations on greenfield investment according to the theory of Directed Technical Change. The results indicate that China's greenfield investment significantly boosts the host countries' GTFP, balancing the relationship between economic development and environmental pollution. Mechanism analysis shows that China's greenfield investment promotes GTFP via industrial structure optimization and technological spillover effect. The former is significant at lower percentiles, while the latter only shows a learning effect without forming an overall demonstration effect to drive endogenous innovation. Compared with host countries' independent environmental regulation, relative environmental regulation presents more effective moderating effects. Heterogeneity tests confirm better moderating roles in medium intensity and developing host countries. This study offers valuable insights into how to better promote the green development impact of investments from developing countries.
abstract_zh: 近年来，发展中国家对外直接投资的激增引发担忧：这些国家环境规制不足，可能通过此类投资对东道国环境产生负面影响。本研究以发展中国家对外直接投资的典型代表为切入点，探讨中国绿地投资对东道国绿色全要素生产率的影响，并基于定向技术变革理论分析环境规制对绿地投资的调节效应。结果表明，中国绿地投资显著提升了东道国的绿色全要素生产率，平衡了经济发展与环境污染之间的关系。机制分析显示，中国绿地投资通过产业结构优化和技术溢出效应促进绿色全要素生产率提升：前者在较低分位数水平上显著，而后者仅呈现学习效应，尚未形成驱动内生创新的整体示范效应。相较于东道国独立环境规制，相对环境规制表现出更有效的调节作用。异质性检验证实，中等强度环境规制及发展中国家东道国的调节效果更优。本研究为如何更好促进发展中国家投资对绿色发展的影响提供了重要启示。

abstract: Digitally deliverable services (DDS) are playing a growing role in global trade, yet empirical evidence on how Aid for Trade (AfT) relates to DDS remains limited. This study examines the bilateral association between AfT and DDS using data for 29 donors and 134 recipients from 2005 to 2019 within a PPML‐based structural gravity framework. AfT is positively associated with DDS exports from donors to recipients, whereas AfT from EU institutions is significantly associated only with DDS imports from EU member states to recipients. Digital trade agreement (DTA) shows positive but limited associations, largely concentrated on donor‐to‐recipient DDS exports. Among AfT components, support for trade‐related infrastructure (INF) and building productive capacity (BPC) are most consistently associated with higher DDS exports, while assistance with trade policy regulation and trade‐related adjustments (TPR) shows weaker links with DDS exports but more frequent associations with higher DDS imports. Sector‐level estimates indicate heterogeneous responses across DDS categories, with stronger associations for non‐LDC and high‐governance recipients. Finally, the results suggest that AfT can help expand digital trade, but its impact would be strong if more support were directed at improving recipients' export capabilities and regulatory frameworks.
abstract_zh: 数字可交付服务（DDS）在全球贸易中的作用日益凸显，但关于"贸易援助"（AfT）与DDS关联性的实证证据仍较为有限。本研究基于2005-2019年29个援助国与134个受援国的数据，采用基于PPML的结构性引力模型框架，考察了AfT与DDS之间的双边关联。研究发现，AfT与援助国对受援国的DDS出口呈正相关，而欧盟机构的AfT仅与欧盟成员国对受援国的DDS进口存在显著关联。数字贸易协定（DTA）虽呈现正向关联但影响有限，主要集中在援助国对受援国的DDS出口领域。在AfT构成要素中，贸易相关基础设施支持（INF）与生产能力建设（BPC）与DDS出口增长关联最为稳定，而贸易政策法规及贸易调整援助（TPR）与DDS出口关联较弱，但与DDS进口增长关联更为频繁。行业层面估计显示，不同DDS类别的反应存在异质性，非最不发达国家及治理水平较高的受援国表现出更强的关联性。最后，研究结果表明AfT有助于扩大数字贸易，但若将更多支持用于提升受援国的出口能力与监管框架，其影响将更为显著。
title: Exploring the Role of Aid for Trade in Promoting Digital Services Trade
title_zh: 探讨贸易援助在促进数字服务贸易中的作用

abstract: This paper examines indications of shifts in the European Union's (EU) import relationships in an increasingly fragmented global trade environment. Using highly disaggregated product‐level trade data, we provide an initial exploration of the reallocation of EU import flows over the 2021–2024 period, considering what these emerging patterns may imply for diversification and price developments. The timing of this analysis is relevant given rising geopolitical uncertainties and the parallel rollout of EU initiatives aimed at enhancing internal capacities and mitigating risks in critical supply chains. Our findings indicate that the EU's supply chains show initial signs of adaptability within the evolving global landscape. Despite sectoral differences, our analysis points to a recent overall shift in EU imports away from countries lacking bilateral trade initiatives with the EU towards the EU itself, as well as neighbouring and distant partners engaged in such initiatives. We find indications that this development is associated with higher overall diversification in EU imports across all partners. However, the reallocation seems more focused on a subset of agreement partners, which may partly reflect the gradual adjustment needed to build capacity elsewhere. In addition, we find mixed evidence of short‐term upward pressure on prices. All in all, the paper aims to highlight emerging trends in EU imports and the related challenges of balancing efficiency and resilience.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在全球贸易环境日益碎片化的背景下，欧盟进口关系发生变化的迹象。利用高度细化的产品层面贸易数据，我们初步探索了2021-2024年期间欧盟进口流的重新配置，并探讨这些新兴模式对多元化和价格发展的潜在影响。鉴于地缘政治不确定性上升，以及欧盟同步推出旨在增强内部能力并降低关键供应链风险的举措，本研究的时机具有现实意义。我们的研究结果表明，欧盟供应链在全球格局演变中展现出初步的适应能力。尽管存在行业差异，但分析指出，近期欧盟进口整体上正从缺乏双边贸易协定的国家转向欧盟自身，以及参与此类协定的邻近和远距离伙伴。我们发现，这一趋势与欧盟进口在所有伙伴中的整体多元化程度提高相关。然而，重新配置似乎更集中于部分协定伙伴，这在一定程度上可能反映了在其他地区建设产能所需的渐进调整过程。此外，关于短期价格上行压力，我们发现了不一致的证据。总体而言，本文旨在揭示欧盟进口的新兴趋势，以及平衡效率与韧性所面临的相关挑战。
title: Supply Chain Tectonics: Empirics on How the EU Is Plotting Its Path Through Global Trade Fragmentation
title_zh: 供应链构造学：欧盟如何在全球贸易碎片化中规划路径的实证研究

abstract: This paper examines how environmental stringency influences firms' participation in Global Value Chains (GVCs) in developing countries. Using the World Bank Enterprise Surveys data, we analyse the effects of domestic environmental regulations and environmental treaties on both the extensive and intensive margins of GVC participation. Our findings reveal that domestic environmental regulations increase firms' likelihood of GVC integration under both simple and strict definitions, lending support to the Porter Hypothesis. Additionally, we find that these positive effects are amplified when firms invest in R&D. Both SMEs and large firms benefit from environmental stringency, with SMEs particularly gaining when they hold foreign certification and have foreign ownership. However, the effect of environmental treaties remains inconclusive, likely due to weak enforcement or vague provisions. The results remain robust in different specifications and after controlling for the endogeneity of such regulations and treaties.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境规制强度如何影响发展中国家企业参与全球价值链（GVCs）的行为。基于世界银行企业调查数据，我们分析了国内环境法规与环境条约对GVC参与广度与深度的影响。研究发现，在简单定义与严格定义下，国内环境法规均能提升企业融入GVC的可能性，这一结果支持了波特假说。此外，我们发现当企业进行研发投入时，这些积极效应会进一步增强。中小企业与大型企业均能从环境规制中获益，其中持有外国认证及外资持股的中小企业获益尤为显著。然而，环境条约的影响尚不明确，这可能是由于执行力度不足或条款模糊所致。在控制法规与条约内生性后，不同模型设定下的结果仍保持稳健。
title: Going Green, Going Global: How Environmental Regulations Foster GVC Integration
title_zh: 绿色转型，全球布局：环境规制如何促进全球价值链整合

abstract: Supplier concentration can enhance resource integration efficiency, but it may also increase dependency risks. Therefore, concerning inventory management, which supply chain structure is more advantageous: diversification or centralization? We utilize data from publicly listed firms in China from 2010 to 2024 to empirically examine the impact of supplier concentration on firms’ lean inventory and its potential mechanisms. The results indicate that supplier concentration generally has a positive effect on firms in promoting lean inventory, thereby supporting the theoretical assumptions dominated by transaction cost economics and embeddedness theory. In addition, from the perspectives of information flow, production flow, and capital flow, we verify that supplier concentration promotes lean inventory in firms by reducing coordination costs, alleviating financing constraints, and enhancing total factor productivity. Focusing on the resource dependence theory, we find that corporate strategy, R&D innovation, and regional marketization of firms amplify the positive effect of supplier concentration on lean inventory. Finally, analysis of segmented inventory type data indicates that supplier concentration significantly drives lean practices in raw materials and work-in-progress inventory, while its impact on lean practices related to finished goods inventory is limited.
abstract_zh: 供应商集中度能够提升资源整合效率，但也可能增加依赖风险。因此，在库存管理方面，供应链结构究竟是多元化还是集中化更具优势？我们利用2010至2024年中国上市公司数据，实证检验供应商集中度对企业精益库存的影响及其潜在机制。结果表明，供应商集中度总体上对企业推进精益库存具有正向效应，从而支持了以交易成本经济学和嵌入性理论为主导的理论假设。此外，从信息流、生产流和资金流视角出发，我们验证了供应商集中度通过降低协调成本、缓解融资约束以及提升全要素生产率来促进企业精益库存。基于资源依赖理论，我们发现企业战略、研发创新及区域市场化程度会放大供应商集中度对精益库存的正向效应。最后，对细分库存类型数据的分析表明，供应商集中度显著推动了原材料和在制品库存的精益实践，但对产成品库存精益实践的影响有限。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Concentrating or dispersing? The impact of supplier concentration on lean inventory
title_zh: 集中还是分散？供应商集中度对精益库存的影响

abstract: We use causal forests to examine how public utility broadband providers are associated with broadband adoption and local market structure across 194 counties in Tennessee and Iowa, 38 of which have a public utility broadband provider. Public provider presence is associated with an average 6% point higher broadband adoption share, lower private-carrier market shares, and lower measured market concentration, though the latter partly reflects the mechanical effect of an additional provider on the concentration index. The estimated adoption difference is largest in lower-income and urban counties and in counties where public providers have greater geographic reach and offer lower prices. Given the cross-sectional design, limited number of treated counties, and the observable income imbalance between treated and untreated counties, we interpret these results as a transparent, explicitly associational account of structured heterogeneity in broadband outcomes rather than as causal estimates; sensitivity analyses indicate that the income heterogeneity patterns are not driven solely by the observable selection margin.
abstract_zh: 我们采用因果森林方法，考察公共事业宽带提供商如何与田纳西州和爱荷华州194个县的宽带普及率及本地市场结构相关联，其中38个县拥有公共事业宽带提供商。公共提供商的存在与宽带普及率平均高出6个百分点、私营运营商市场份额降低以及市场集中度下降相关——尽管后者部分反映了新增提供商对集中度指数的机械性影响。宽带普及率差异在低收入县、城市县以及公共提供商地理覆盖范围更广、定价更低的县中最为显著。鉴于本研究采用横截面设计、受处理县数量有限，且受处理县与未受处理县之间存在可观测的收入不平衡，我们将这些结果解读为对宽带结果中结构化异质性的透明、明确关联性描述，而非因果估计；敏感性分析表明，收入异质性模式并非仅由可观测的选择性边界驱动。
title: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
title_zh: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争

abstract: We study setups where the winner of a qualifying Tullock contest can participate in a subsequent sport competition where their relative performance depends on initial efforts at the qualifying stage. If the qualifying contest is staged in favour of a team, the cheating team always sees its qualifying probability improve. The effect on investments, however, is non-monotonic: for mild levels of cheating, the higher likelihood of qualifying for the subsequent competition strengthens the cheating team’s incentives to invest, raising its effort above the unbiased benchmark; for intense levels of cheating, the near-certainty of qualifying eliminates the incentive to compete for the local prize, and the cheating team drastically cuts its investments. The rival team, on the other hand, always reduces its equilibrium effort as corruption becomes more intense. The cheating player has incentives to carry out illegal activities since his payoff increases in cheating. In such corrupt qualifiers, the champion tends to be the cheating player, and the representative from this qualifying group in the subsequent competition will perform worse if corruption is intense.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种赛制：在资格赛阶段通过Tullock竞赛胜出的队伍，可参与后续体育赛事，而该队伍在后续赛事中的相对表现取决于其在资格赛阶段的初始努力。若资格赛存在偏向某支队伍的舞弊行为，则该作弊队伍进入资格赛的概率始终会提高。然而，舞弊对投资的影响呈现非单调性：在轻度舞弊水平下，进入后续赛事概率的提升会增强作弊队伍的投资激励，使其努力水平高于无偏基准；在重度舞弊水平下，近乎确定的晋级资格消除了争夺本地奖项的激励，导致作弊队伍大幅削减投资。另一方面，随着腐败程度加剧，对手队伍始终会降低其均衡努力水平。由于作弊者的收益随舞弊程度增加而上升，其具有实施非法行为的激励。在此类腐败资格赛中，冠军往往由作弊队伍获得，且若腐败程度严重，该资格赛群体在后续赛事中的代表队伍表现将更差。
title: The dire consequences of a corrupt sport contest
title_zh: 腐败体育竞赛的严重后果

abstract: Digital transformation is a central policy priority, yet its benefits remain unevenly distributed across individuals and countries. Digital inequalities are multidimensional, encompassing both objective aspects, such as access, use, and outcomes, and subjective dimensions, including perceptions, motivation, and behaviours. This article examines the factors associated with individuals’ perceptions of the importance of digitalization, using data from Eurobarometer 99.1. The analysis focuses on socio-demographic characteristics, internet use, attitudinal variables related to digital policies, and the national context. Binary and multilevel logistic regression models are employed to account for both individual and country-level influences. The findings show that perceptions of digitalization are more strongly associated with individual factors than with cross-country differences. Socio-economic characteristics are relevant, with education and income positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization, while age shows a negative association. Attitudinal variables related to digital education, access, and infrastructure display significant associations. At the country level, the share of individuals with basic digital skills (DESI) is positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization and explains part of the variation between countries. This study contributes to the literature on digital inequalities by focusing on attitudes towards digitalization and by highlighting the interplay between individual and contextual factors.
abstract_zh: 数字化转型是核心政策重点，但其收益在个体和国家间仍分布不均。数字不平等具有多维性，既涵盖接入、使用和结果等客观层面，也包含认知、动机和行为等主观维度。本文利用欧洲晴雨表99.1数据，考察与个体对数字化重要性认知相关的因素。分析聚焦于社会人口特征、互联网使用、与数字政策相关的态度变量以及国家背景。采用二元和多层次逻辑回归模型来同时考虑个体和国家层面的影响。研究结果表明，与跨国差异相比，个体因素与数字化认知的关联更为显著。社会经济特征具有相关性：教育程度和收入与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，而年龄则呈负相关。与数字教育、接入和基础设施相关的态度变量表现出显著关联。在国家层面，具备基础数字技能的人口比例（DESI）与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，并解释了部分国家间差异。本研究通过聚焦数字化态度并强调个体与情境因素的相互作用，为数字不平等文献做出贡献。
title: Perceived importance of digitalization in the European Union: a multilevel analysis of individual and country-level determinants
title_zh: 欧盟数字化感知重要性：个体与国家层面决定因素的多层次分析

abstract: We study the complexity of determining a winning committee under the Chamberlin–Courant voting rule when voters’ preferences are single-crossing on a line, or, more generally, on a median graph (this class of graphs includes, e.g., trees and grids). For the line, Skowron et al. (2015) describe an $$\varvec{O}(\varvec{n}^{\varvec{2}}\varvec{mk})$$ O ( n 2 mk ) algorithm (where $$\varvec{n}$$ n , $$\varvec{m}$$ m , $$\varvec{k}$$ k are the number of voters, the number of candidates and the committee size, respectively); we show that a simple tweak improves the time complexity to $$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$ O ( n m k ) . We then improve this bound even further by reducing our problem to the $$\varvec{k}$$ k -link path problem for complete DAGs with Monge-concave weights, obtaining an $$\varvec{O(n}^{\varvec{1 + o(1)}}\varvec{m})$$ O ( n 1 + o ( 1 ) m ) algorithm for arbitrary misrepresentation functions and a nearly linear algorithm for the Borda misrepresentation function. For trees, we point out an issue with the algorithm proposed by Clearwater et al. (2015), and develop an $$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$ O ( n m k ) algorithm for this case as well. For grids, we formulate a conjecture about the structure of optimal solutions, and describe a polynomial-time algorithm that finds a winning committee if this conjecture is true; we also explain how to convert this algorithm into a bicriterial approximation algorithm whose correctness does not depend on the conjecture.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究在选民偏好满足直线单峰性，或更一般地在中间图（此类图包括树和网格等）上满足单峰性时，基于Chamberlin–Courant投票规则确定获胜委员会的复杂度问题。针对直线情形，Skowron等人（2015）提出了一个$$\varvec{O}(\varvec{n}^{\varvec{2}}\varvec{mk})$$ O ( n 2 mk ) 算法（其中$$\varvec{n}$$ n 、$$\varvec{m}$$ m 、$$\varvec{k}$$ k 分别表示选民数、候选人数和委员会规模）；我们证明通过简单调整可将时间复杂度改进至$$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$ O ( n m k ) 。进一步地，通过将问题归约为具有Monge-凹权重的完全有向无环图的$$\varvec{k}$$ k -链路路径问题，我们针对任意失真函数获得了$$\varvec{O(n}^{\varvec{1 + o(1)}}\varvec{m})$$ O ( n 1 + o ( 1 ) m ) 算法，并针对Borda失真函数提出了近线性算法。对于树形结构，我们指出Clearwater等人（2015）算法中存在的问题，并为此情形同样开发了$$\varvec{O(nmk)}$$ O ( n m k ) 算法。针对网格结构，我们提出了关于最优解结构的猜想，并描述了在该猜想成立时可在多项式时间内找到获胜委员会的算法；同时说明如何将该算法转化为不依赖该猜想的双准则近似算法。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Proportional representation under single-crossing preferences revisited
title_zh: 单交叉偏好下的比例代表制再探讨

abstract: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 《经济学期刊》本期特刊汇集了运用动态、空间及异质性主体结构模型研究气候变化与气候政策的前沿论文。这些模型旨在与气候科学基本原理保持一致，并经过校准和/或实证数据验证。基于此，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger与Schenk为本期特刊贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可嵌入气候变化经济模型的高效气候模拟器。围绕气候变化与不平等之间的关联，本期论文涵盖了气候变化及各类减缓政策（尤其是碳税）影响中不同且常具互补性的异质性维度。综合来看，这些研究表明：气候行动分配效应的关键取决于政策实施地点、市场如何跨区域和国家传导冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区通过收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征面临最大风险。
title: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
title_zh: 特刊：气候变化与不平等

abstract: Empirical evidence shows that environmental, social, and governance (ESG) quality interacts with financial performance at the individual asset level: high-ESG firms outperform during crises and corporate social responsibility lowers systematic beta. Models with separable ESG preferences generate a greenium but no such interaction. We develop a capital asset pricing model (CAPM) with supermodular preferences over each asset’s return and ESG score. The equilibrium features an asset-specific denominator that compresses expected returns for high-ESG assets and generates a negative beta-ESG interaction, implying lower effective market sensitivity for green firms. We show that portfolio-level complementarity cannot produce this interaction, which yields a sharp test distinguishing our mechanism in the data. The model offers one rationalization of the beta-ESG interaction. We illustrate its quantitative content with four empirical studies.
abstract_zh: 实证证据表明，环境、社会和治理（ESG）质量在个体资产层面与财务绩效相互作用：高ESG企业在危机期间表现更优，且企业社会责任降低了系统性贝塔值。具有可分离ESG偏好的模型虽能产生绿色溢价，却无法解释这种相互作用。我们构建了一个资本资产定价模型（CAPM），其中包含对每项资产回报率与ESG评分的超模偏好。均衡状态下，模型呈现资产特定的分母，压缩了高ESG资产的预期回报，并产生负向的贝塔-ESG交互效应，意味着绿色企业的有效市场敏感度较低。我们证明，投资组合层面的互补性无法产生这种交互作用，这为在数据中区分我们的机制提供了一个明确的检验标准。该模型为贝塔-ESG交互效应提供了一种合理化解释。我们通过四项实证研究展示了其定量内容。
title: Doing good and doing well: A CAPM with complementary ESG and financial returns
title_zh: 行善与盈利：兼具ESG与财务回报互补性的CAPM模型

abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。
title: Difference-in-differences with unit-specific trends: Bias in post-treatment estimates and a simple alternative
title_zh: 单位特定趋势下的双重差分法：处理后估计的偏差及一个简单替代方案

abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment has moved in less than a decade from dominant paradigm to contested terrain. This paper examines the rise and recent retreat of ESG in corporate governance and financial markets. We document a marked decline in ESG engagement across corporate commitments, investor coalitions, and corporate communications. While the backlash is most visible in the United States, similar patterns appear globally, indicating deeper structural weaknesses in the ESG model. ESG relied heavily on voluntary coordination and the promise that firms could “do well by doing good”—claims that proved fragile under political and market pressure. We argue that sustainability efforts should refocus on environmental risk through a narrower framework: Transition, Emissions, and Resource Risk Accountability (TERRA).
abstract_zh: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资在不到十年间从主导范式转变为争议领域。本文考察了ESG在公司治理与金融市场中的兴起与近期退潮。我们记录了ESG在企业承诺、投资者联盟及企业沟通中的显著衰退。尽管这一反弹在美国最为明显，但全球范围内也出现了类似模式，表明ESG模式存在更深层次的结构性缺陷。ESG高度依赖自愿协调以及企业能够"行善获利"的承诺——这些主张在政治与市场压力下被证明是脆弱的。我们认为，可持续发展努力应通过更聚焦的框架重新聚焦于环境风险：转型、排放与资源风险问责（TERRA）。
title: ESG is Dead, They Say. Long Live TERRA
title_zh: 他们说ESG已死，TERRA万岁

abstract: We review the evidence on the impact of private equity (PE) ownership on firms, stakeholders, and the economy. We organize this literature using a framework that emphasizes the costs and benefits of PE as an ownership form and implies five main predictions: (i) only some firms are natural PE targets; (ii) PE ownership is optimally temporary; (iii) debt is typically a cheaper source of capital than PE equity; (iv) PE activity is strongly cyclical; and (v) the PE model is a second-best response to underlying agency and contracting frictions. We use this framework to interpret existing evidence and to clarify when, and for whom, PE ownership creates value.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了私募股权（PE）所有权对企业、利益相关者及经济影响的实证证据。我们通过一个强调PE作为所有权形式的成本与收益的分析框架来组织相关文献，该框架隐含五个主要预测：（i）仅部分企业是天然的PE收购目标；（ii）PE所有权具有最优的暂时性特征；（iii）债务通常比PE股权更具成本优势；（iv）PE活动呈现强周期性；（v）PE模式是对潜在代理问题与契约摩擦的次优应对方案。我们运用该框架解释现有证据，并阐明PE所有权在何种情境下、为哪些主体创造价值。
title: Private Equity Ownership and Firm Performance: A Framework for Interpreting the Evidence
title_zh: 私募股权所有权与企业绩效：证据解释框架

abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000–2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.
abstract_zh: 碳定价如何影响棕色企业的投资？在2000年至2019年间，瑞典制造业企业的有效碳排放成本上升了约400%。尽管运营利润率下降，高排放企业仍显著增加了总资本投资以及用于减排的投资份额。这一反应集中在内部财务能力较强的企业中。我们在低排放企业或瑞典以外的高排放行业中未发现类似的投资增长。研究结果表明，将二氧化碳排放定价在足够高的水平，能够激励棕色企业进行绿色投资。
title: Carbon Pricing and Investment
title_zh: 碳定价与投资

abstract: We examine the effect of macroprudential policy on innovation across 21 European countries from 1990 to 2021. Using 401,755 patents linked to 2,844 firms, we find that macroprudential tightening reduces both the quantity and quality of innovation. One standard deviation increase in the overall macroprudential policy index is associated with approximately a 10.1 percent decline in patent count and an 8.4 percent decline in adjusted forward citations. The effect is persistent and robust across three identification strategies: a multi-way fixed effects specification, an instrumental variable approach, and a difference-in-differences design exploiting the implementation of the European Union’s macroprudential “single rulebook” (CRR/CRD IV). The effect operates through the credit channel, is amplified for financially constrained firms, and is driven by credit-oriented, borrower-targeted, and credit cycle-smoothing instruments. Financial resilience-building instruments deliver no short term cost and possibly generate positive innovation effects at long horizons. The findings suggest that the macroprudential toolkit carries differentiated economic costs across instrument categories.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1990年至2021年间21个欧洲国家宏观审慎政策对创新的影响。基于2844家企业关联的401755项专利数据，我们发现宏观审慎政策收紧会同时降低创新的数量与质量。整体宏观审慎政策指数每增加一个标准差，专利数量约下降10.1%，经调整的前向引用次数约下降8.4%。该效应具有持续性，并在三种识别策略中保持稳健：多向固定效应模型、工具变量法，以及利用欧盟宏观审慎"单一规则手册"（CRR/CRD IV）实施构建的双重差分设计。该效应通过信贷渠道传导，在融资约束较强的企业中更为显著，且主要由信贷导向型、借款人定向型及信贷周期平滑型工具驱动。增强金融韧性的工具在短期内未产生成本，并可能在长期产生正向创新效应。研究结果表明，不同类别的宏观审慎工具具有差异化的经济成本。
title: Macroprudential policy and corporate innovation: Evidence from European countries
title_zh: 宏观审慎政策与企业创新：来自欧洲国家的证据

abstract: This paper provides a critical review of the Too Much Finance literature, both in its academic contribution and as response to the earlier finance and growth literature. We describe the academic origins and development of the finance and growth literature and discuss pitfalls with the commonly used indicators of financial development. We explore how the finance and growth research findings can be translated into policy recommendations including with respect to the trade-off between growth and stability. Finally, we argue that the the question of ‘can there be too much finance’ contains actually three questions: can there be too much credit, can there be too large a financial sector, and can there be too much financial development.
abstract_zh: 本文对“过度金融化”文献进行了批判性评述，既探讨其学术贡献，也将其视为对早期金融与增长文献的回应。我们描述了金融与增长文献的学术起源与发展脉络，并讨论了常用金融发展指标存在的缺陷。我们探究了金融与增长的研究发现如何转化为政策建议，包括在增长与稳定之间的权衡问题。最后，我们认为“是否存在过度金融化”这一问题实际上包含三个子问题：是否存在过度信贷、是否存在过大的金融部门、以及是否存在过度的金融发展。
title: Can there be too much finance? A complex answer to a simple question
title_zh: 金融是否可能过度？一个简单问题的复杂答案

abstract: People with mental illness are frequently discriminated against and stigmatized. We introduce a new measure of perceived depression stigma and examine the causal effect of perceived stigma on help-seeking in a sample of 1844 Americans suffering from depression. We document that a large majority of our participants overestimate the extent of stigma associated with depression. An informational intervention aimed at reducing perceived social stigma decreases the demand for psychotherapy. Merely prompting individuals to think about stigma has a similar effect. A mechanism experiment reveals that our interventions increase both participants’ optimism about future mental health and their readiness to rely on friends and family, thereby reducing the perceived need for therapy.
abstract_zh: 精神疾病患者常遭受歧视与污名化。我们引入了一种新的感知抑郁污名测量方法，并在1844名患有抑郁症的美国样本中，考察了感知污名对求助行为的因果效应。研究发现，绝大多数参与者高估了与抑郁症相关的污名程度。一项旨在降低感知社会污名的信息干预措施，减少了对心理治疗的需求。仅提示个体思考污名问题，也产生了类似效果。机制实验表明，我们的干预措施既提升了参与者对未来心理健康的乐观程度，也增强了他们依赖亲友的意愿，从而降低了对治疗必要性的感知。
title: Depression stigma
title_zh: 抑郁污名

abstract: We study how localized gasoline price shocks affect household consumption by linking high-frequency bank transaction data with station-level fuel prices. A 1% increase in local gasoline prices reduces monthly household spending by approximately 0.13%, even after controlling for national fuel price movements. We identify two mechanisms. First, spending declines are larger among fuel-dependent, low-liquidity households, consistent with a budget-constraint channel. Second, highly visible local price spikes reduce spending even among non-car households, consistent with a price-salience channel. We further show that localized gasoline price shocks amplify consumption inequality: low-income households with high fuel exposure experience the largest reductions, particularly in discretionary spending. Our findings show that localized energy price fluctuations shape household consumption through both financial constraints and behavioral responses to salient price signals.
abstract_zh: 我们通过将高频银行交易数据与加油站级别的燃油价格相关联，研究局部汽油价格冲击如何影响家庭消费。即使控制了全国燃油价格变动，当地汽油价格每上涨1%，每月家庭支出约减少0.13%。我们识别出两种机制。首先，在依赖燃油且流动性低的家庭中，支出下降幅度更大，这与预算约束渠道一致。其次，高度可见的局部价格飙升甚至减少了无车家庭的支出，这与价格显著性渠道相符。我们进一步表明，局部汽油价格冲击加剧了消费不平等：燃油暴露度高的低收入家庭经历最大幅度的支出削减，尤其是在可自由支配支出方面。我们的研究结果显示，局部能源价格波动通过财务约束和对显著价格信号的行为反应，共同塑造家庭消费。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
title_zh: 燃油心智：地方汽油价格如何影响家庭消费

abstract: Experiments from psychology show that people associate northern locations on arbitrary maps with positive value, raising the possibility that this cognitive bias shapes real housing markets. Using parcel-level data on 1.1 million residential properties across 285 cities in the northeastern United States, we find that houses in the northern parts of cities indeed sell at higher market prices. This premium disappears once lot size is controlled for, the only housing characteristic with this property. We argue that a small psychological preference for northness, too small to register as a direct price premium yet large enough to act as a Schelling focal point, could lead to neighborhood sorting and generate these differences in housing quality between the northern and southern parts of cities.
abstract_zh: 心理学实验表明，人们会将任意地图上的北方位置与正向价值相关联，这引发了一种可能性：这种认知偏差可能影响真实的住房市场。基于美国东北部285个城市110万套住宅的地块级数据，我们发现城市北部地区的房屋确实以更高的市场价格成交。一旦控制地块面积这一唯一具有此特性的住房属性，该溢价便消失。我们认为，一种微小的对北方的心理偏好——小到不足以直接体现为价格溢价，却足以作为谢林焦点——可能引发社区分层，并导致城市南北部之间住房质量的差异。
title: Uptown Worlds: Directional Bias and House Prices in U.S. Cities
title_zh: 上城世界：美国城市中的方向性偏差与房价

abstract: In physics the famous von Neumann measurement model assumes that - apart from measurement noise - the data is aligned with the model. In economics and finance, models are prone to specification errors. Decision theory has offered insights into statistical inference given uncertainty in the data generating process. Quantum behavioral models have resolved longstanding paradoxes facing decision theory by allowing candidate decisions to behave like quantum mechanical states in superposition. We introduce quantum decision-theoretic foundations of ambiguity and model/parameter uncertainty to deal with model selection and specification errors. We provide an illustrative example involving asset pricing models.
abstract_zh: 在物理学中，著名的冯·诺依曼测量模型假设数据与模型对齐，除测量噪声外。而在经济学与金融领域，模型易受设定误差影响。决策理论已为数据生成过程不确定性下的统计推断提供了洞见。量子行为模型通过允许候选决策像量子力学态一样处于叠加状态，解决了决策理论面临的长期悖论。我们引入量子决策理论基础，以处理模糊性及模型/参数不确定性，应对模型选择与设定误差问题。我们提供了一个涉及资产定价模型的示例说明。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: On Statistical Decision-Theoretical Foundations of Quantum Measurement with an Application to Asset Pricing Models
title_zh: 量子测量统计决策理论基础及其在资产定价模型中的应用

abstract: In this paper, we analyze the impact of public dental care coverage – universal versus targeted – on access, pricing, and public spending in a model with two competing dental practices and heterogeneous patient income groups. We evaluate two types of reimbursement schemes: fixed subsidies and cost sharing. Our findings show that public coverage improves access for low‐income patients but increases producer prices due to reduced price elasticity of demand. Targeted coverage provides greater access at lower public cost compared with universal coverage, especially under cost‐sharing schemes. With fixed subsidies, both schemes achieve similar access, but targeted coverage remains more cost‐efficient. The policy that maximizes utilitarian welfare is targeted coverage with a fixed subsidy, balancing improved access for low‐income patients against higher prices for high‐income patients. This trade‐off highlights challenges in implementing targeted policies but provides insights for designing efficient and equitable public dental care systems.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个包含两家竞争性牙科诊所和异质性患者收入群体的模型中，分析了公共牙科保险覆盖（全民覆盖与定向覆盖）对可及性、定价及公共支出的影响。我们评估了两种报销机制：固定补贴与成本分摊。研究结果表明，公共覆盖改善了低收入患者的可及性，但由于需求价格弹性降低，导致生产者价格上涨。与全民覆盖相比，定向覆盖能以更低的公共成本实现更高的可及性，尤其在成本分摊机制下更为显著。在固定补贴机制下，两种覆盖方案的可及性相近，但定向覆盖仍更具成本效率。实现功利主义社会福利最大化的政策是采用固定补贴的定向覆盖方案，该方案在改善低收入患者可及性与提高高收入患者价格之间取得平衡。这一权衡凸显了实施定向政策的挑战，但为设计高效且公平的公共牙科保险体系提供了启示。
title: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
title_zh: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？

abstract: Comprehensive land consolidation (CLC) has emerged as a policy toolkit for lots of countries and regions to promote the integrated territorial governance. While multi-stakeholder collaboration is fundamental to CLC’s success, previous studies have typically adopted a static lens, neglecting the dynamic nature of stakeholder interactions and role evolution in a project’s lifecycle. To address this gap, this study develops a phased framework to unpack the dynamic collaborative mechanisms across the CLC lifecycle. Drawing on and extending the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework, this study deconstructs the CLC process into three sequential stages: planning, implementation, and operation. Subsequently, the “Tianlifang Future Farm” in Hangzhou, China, is used as a case study to empirically examine this framework, mapping the shifting interplay and power dynamics between government, enterprises, village collectives, and farmers. Research findings reveal that effective governance hinges on stage-specific mechanisms, including a planning revision mechanism to align divergent stakeholder interests within regulatory constraints, a consensus-building mechanism to facilitate low-conflict project execution, and a market-driven mechanism to ensure long-term operational viability. However, two critical weaknesses are identified in the state-orchestrated model that could lead to the marginalization of community interest, namely structural decoupling and skewed benefit-sharing between enterprises and farmers. This study, therefore, proposes targeted policy interventions centered on institutionalized proactive engagement and diversified equity-sharing models are proposed. In sum, this study not only transcends static governance by offering a longitudinal and process-oriednted framework for collaborative land policy, but also provides actionable insights for sustainable global land consolidation initiatives.
abstract_zh: 全域土地综合整治（CLC）已成为众多国家和地区推动区域一体化治理的政策工具。尽管多方利益相关者协作是CLC成功的基础，但以往研究通常采用静态视角，忽视了项目生命周期中利益相关者互动及角色演变的动态特性。为弥补这一不足，本研究构建了一个分阶段框架，以揭示CLC全过程中的动态协作机制。借鉴并拓展制度分析与发展（IAD）框架，本研究将CLC过程解构为三个连续阶段：规划、实施与运营。随后，以中国杭州“田立方未来农场”为案例进行实证检验，描绘政府、企业、村集体与农民之间互动关系及权力动态的转变。研究发现，有效治理依赖于阶段特定机制，包括在监管约束下协调多元利益相关者诉求的规划修订机制、促进低冲突项目执行的共识构建机制，以及确保长期运营可行性的市场驱动机制。然而，国家主导模式中存在两个可能导致社区利益边缘化的关键缺陷，即结构性脱节与企业—农民间利益分配失衡。为此，本研究提出以制度化主动参与和多元化股权共享模式为核心的政策干预建议。综上，本研究不仅通过提供纵向、过程导向的协作性土地政策框架超越了静态治理视角，还为全球可持续土地整治实践提供了可操作的见解。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: From static to dynamic: A phased evolution framework for multi-stakeholder collaborative governance in comprehensive land consolidation
title_zh: 从静态到动态：全域土地综合整治中多主体协同治理的分阶段演进框架

abstract: We propose an approach to estimate how individuals’ expectations influence their responses to a counterfactual change. The approach relies on average partial effects, which recover counterfactual impacts under conditions that we specify. We propose a three-step estimation method that relies on panel data on subjective expectations. We illustrate our approach in a model of consumption and saving, focusing on the impact of an income tax that not only changes current income but also affects beliefs about future income. Applying our approach to Italian survey data, we find that individuals’ beliefs matter for evaluating the impact of tax policies on consumption decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法来估计个体的预期如何影响其对反事实变化的反应。该方法依赖于平均部分效应，在我们指定的条件下，这些效应能够恢复反事实影响。我们提出一种三步估计方法，该方法依赖于主观预期的面板数据。我们在一个消费与储蓄模型中展示我们的方法，重点关注所得税的影响，该税种不仅改变当前收入，还影响对未来收入的信念。将我们的方法应用于意大利调查数据，我们发现个体的信念对于评估税收政策对消费决策的影响至关重要。
title: Estimating individual responses when tomorrow matters
title_zh: 当明天至关重要时：个体反应的估计

abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and---in plausibly-specified simulations---quantitatively at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
abstract_zh: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的经典受益型劳动收入税，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率实现的收入再分配是一致的，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其量化水平也反映了美国过去几十年的政策实践。由于再分配在实践中普遍存在，我们的研究结果消除了受益原则作为税收政策主流规范基础可信性的一大障碍。
title: Benefit-Based Taxation can Include Substantial Redistribution
title_zh: 基于受益的税收可以包含显著的再分配

abstract: Ambient air pollution contributes substantially to premature mortality globally, and the effectiveness of policies addressing it depends critically on the shape of the dose-response relationship, which remains poorly understood. Linking hourly air pollution data with daily vital statistics from 251 Chinese cities over four years, we show this relationship depends not only on the mean, but also on the variance of within-period exposure. At a 7-day mean of 150 μg/m³, predicted mortality varies more across observed hourly PM2.5 distributions than across mean exposure differences of 100 μg/m³. The sign of this variance effect also depends on the mean: at low mean concentrations (a convex region), higher variance is associated with modestly higher mortality. At higher concentrations (a concave region), greater variance is associated with lower mortality – implying constant exposure is more harmful than fluctuating exposure for a given mean. These findings reveal important relationships masked using temporally aggregated air pollution data.
abstract_zh: 环境空气污染是全球过早死亡的重要诱因，而相关政策的有效性关键取决于剂量-反应关系的形态，但目前对此认知仍不充分。通过将中国251个城市四年的逐时空气污染数据与每日生命统计数据相关联，我们发现这种关系不仅取决于时段内暴露的均值，还取决于其方差。在7天均值为150 μg/m³的条件下，基于观测到的逐时PM2.5分布差异所预测的死亡率变化，甚至超过均值暴露差异达100 μg/m³时的影响。这种方差效应的方向也取决于均值：在低均值浓度（凸性区域）下，较高方差与死亡率适度上升相关；而在高浓度（凹性区域）下，较大方差则与死亡率下降相关——这意味着在给定均值条件下，持续暴露比波动暴露更具危害性。这些发现揭示了使用时间聚合空气污染数据时被掩盖的重要关联关系。
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用中国251个城市的空气污染与死亡数据，核心研究对象是中国地区。
title: Beyond Mean Exposure: How Exposure Variance Shapes Air Pollution Mortality Risk
title_zh: 超越均值暴露：暴露方差如何塑造空气污染死亡风险

abstract: We study the effect of drug decriminalization on overdose mortality using Oregon's Measure 110 and Washington's Blake decision. Synthetic-control estimates show that both decriminalization regimes sharply reduced drug arrests and were followed by sustained increases in overdose mortality relative to matched counterfactuals. The estimates imply approximately 1,186 excess deaths in Oregon and 1,895 in Washington from 2021 through 2023. We also revisit the role of fentanyl supply shocks. A fentanyl-share control may partly capture enforcement-driven declines in non-fentanyl NFLIS reports, while alternative fentanyl measures leave positive overdose effects.
abstract_zh: 我们利用俄勒冈州的110号法案和华盛顿州的布莱克判决，研究毒品非刑事化对过量致死率的影响。合成控制法估计显示，两种非刑事化制度均大幅减少了毒品逮捕，但与匹配的反事实相比，随后出现了过量致死率的持续上升。这些估计表明，从2021年到2023年，俄勒冈州约有1186例超额死亡，华盛顿州约有1895例。我们还重新审视了芬太尼供应冲击的作用。芬太尼份额控制可能部分捕捉到执法驱动的非芬太尼NFLIS报告减少，而替代性芬太尼指标则留下了正向的过量致死效应。
title: Did Drug Decriminalization Increase Overdoses
title_zh: 毒品非刑事化是否增加了药物过量

abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察医院质量、患者选择及拥堵状况对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制不可观测的选择效应。重症监护病房负荷加剧了医院死亡率：若无拥堵，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析表明：若患者获知容量压力信息且认为质量信号更精确，死亡率将下降3.8%。然而，若使用更精确的信息却未考虑拥堵因素，新冠死亡人数反而会上升3.8%。
title: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
title_zh: 质量、选择与拥堵：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果

abstract: The fertility decline is everywhere in the world today and goes back decades for rich countries. Birthrates have been below replacement in the U.S. and Europe since the mid-1970s. Completed cohort fertility in the U.S. was lower for those born in 1955 than for 1975. The reasons for the initial declines involve greater female autonomy and a mismatch between the desires of men and women. Men generally benefit more from maintaining traditions; women often benefit more from eschewing them. When the probability is low that men will abandon traditions, some career women will not have children and others will delay.
abstract_zh: 当今世界普遍存在生育率下降现象，富裕国家的这一趋势已持续数十年。自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国和欧洲的生育率一直低于更替水平。美国1955年出生队列的终身生育率低于1975年出生队列。生育率最初下降的原因涉及女性自主权增强以及男女意愿的错配。男性通常更倾向于维持传统，而女性往往更受益于摒弃传统。当男性放弃传统的可能性较低时，部分职业女性会选择不生育，另一些则会推迟生育。
title: The Rise of Female Autonomy and the Decline of Fertility: The Role of Mismatch
title_zh: 女性自主权的上升与生育率的下降：错配的作用

abstract: Relatively little is known about occupational licensing across nations. Despite a large literature on occupational licensing in the United States, cross-national evidence remains scarce, especially for developing economies. We assemble harmonized estimates of licensing prevalence for 44 countries by combining new nationally representative surveys (including newly conducted nationally representative surveys for a number of previously unstudied countries) for several Latin American, African, Asian, European, and North American estimates. We document substantial cross-country dispersion in occupational licensing prevalence, ranging from roughly 14 percent of workers in Denmark to more than 40 percent in India and South Africa, the two most heavily licensed labor markets in our sample. Across countries, licensed workers generally earn higher wages than comparable unlicensed workers, with pooled Mincerian regressions indicating licensing wage premia ranging from roughly 6 to 19 percent depending on weighting and specification choices. Occupational licensing prevalence is also negatively associated with GDP per capita and governance quality, and positively associated with informal employment. While these relationships are descriptive rather than causal, they suggest that occupational licensing may be intertwined with broader institutional characteristics affecting labor market efficiency, formal-sector participation, and long-run economic development.
abstract_zh: 关于各国职业许可的研究相对较少。尽管美国已有大量关于职业许可的文献，但跨国证据仍然稀缺，尤其是针对发展中经济体。我们通过整合新的全国代表性调查（包括针对多个此前未被研究的国家新开展的全国代表性调查），为拉丁美洲、非洲、亚洲、欧洲和北美的44个国家构建了统一的职业许可普及率估计值。我们记录了各国职业许可普及率的显著差异，从丹麦约14%的工人到印度和南非超过40%——这两个样本中职业许可程度最高的劳动力市场。跨国数据显示，持有职业许可的工人通常比未持许可的同类工人获得更高工资，混合明瑟回归表明，根据权重和模型设定选择的不同，职业许可工资溢价约为6%至19%。职业许可普及率还与人均GDP和治理质量呈负相关，与非正规就业呈正相关。尽管这些关系是描述性而非因果性的，但它们表明职业许可可能与影响劳动力市场效率、正规部门参与度及长期经济发展的更广泛制度特征相互交织。
title: Analyzing Occupational Licensing Across Nations
title_zh: 跨国职业许可制度分析

abstract: People often make important choices in pursuit of higher income, but do they place too much weight on income when deciding what path to take? We propose a simple model of misspecified learning in which individuals overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income—the expected effect of an income increase on overall life satisfaction—and therefore give income too much importance in their decisions. Guided by this model, we designed a pre-registered experiment that elicits beliefs about the marginal satisfaction from income and randomly assigns scientific evidence about it. Respondents substantially overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income both for themselves and for others, but especially for themselves. These biases shrink when respondents are exposed to scientific evidence, and the effects persist one month later. To study whether these beliefs matter for behavior, we measure income-versus-non-income trade-offs using job-choice scenarios tailored to each respondent and a real-world decision the respondent is facing. To elicit the latter, we make a methodological contribution: an AI-led interview method that moves beyond static, predefined survey instruments by combining the flexibility of qualitative interviewing with the discipline of closed-ended survey measurement. We find that biased beliefs are consequential: after learning that income matters less for life satisfaction than they initially thought, respondents place less weight on income in their decisions.
abstract_zh: 人们常常为了追求更高收入而做出重要选择，但他们在决策时是否过度看重收入？我们提出了一个简单的错误学习模型，其中个体高估了收入的边际满意度——即收入增长对整体生活满意度的预期影响——因此在决策中赋予收入过高的权重。在该模型指导下，我们设计了一项预注册实验，通过诱导被试对收入边际满意度的信念，并随机分配关于该问题的科学证据。被试显著高估了自身及他人的收入边际满意度，尤其对自身的高估更为严重。当被试接触科学证据后，这些偏差有所缩小，且效果在持续一个月后依然存在。为探究这些信念是否影响行为，我们通过针对每位被试定制的职业选择场景以及其面临的实际决策，衡量收入与非收入之间的权衡。为获取后者，我们做出了一项方法论贡献：采用人工智能引导的访谈方法，该方法结合了定性访谈的灵活性与封闭式调查测量的规范性，突破了静态、预定义的调查工具。研究发现，偏差信念具有显著影响：当被试了解到收入对生活满意度的影响低于其最初预期后，他们在决策中对收入的重视程度有所降低。
title: Is Money Overrated? Misperceived Satisfaction from Income
title_zh: 金钱被高估了吗？收入带来的满足感被误解

abstract: Vehicle inspections—commonly known as smog and safety checks—are often delegated to private agents, much like other quality certification markets. When these agents compete, they face incentives to misreport quality—especially when consumers do not internalize the external costs of misreporting. Theory and evidence from Chile’s concentrated vehicle-inspection markets suggest that these incentives are significant: misreporting emerges as soon as competition is introduced. We find that delegating each market to a single agent proves effective in reducing approval rates, without compromising service quality or the ex-ante competition for the market, while delivering substantial and permanent reductions in vehicle emissions.
abstract_zh: 车辆检测——通常称为尾气与安全检查——常被委托给私人代理机构，这与许多质量认证市场类似。当这些代理机构相互竞争时，它们面临虚报质量的动机——尤其是在消费者未将虚报的外部成本内部化的情况下。来自智利集中型车辆检测市场的理论与证据表明，这些动机十分显著：一旦引入竞争，虚报行为便随之出现。研究发现，将每个市场委托给单一代理机构能有效降低通过率，且不会损害服务质量或市场的事前竞争，同时实现车辆排放的显著且持久减少。
title: Competition and Misconduct in Certification Markets with Externalities
title_zh: 外部性下认证市场的竞争与不当行为

abstract: We show that quantitative easing (QE) worsens government debt sustainability. In our model, the government has a negative primary balance and downward-sloping debt demand that makes interest rates endogenous. The central bank has long-term capital and remits profits to the fiscal authority. QE depletes this capital stock, reducing future remittances and crisis-fighting reserves. Contrary to Sargent and Wallace (1981), where greater monetary accommodation lowers the steady-state debt level, we show that QE increases the steady-state level of debt and shifts the default boundary inward, thus heightening fragility and reducing debt sustainability. Moreover, while QE can keep interest rates low for extended periods, sustaining a QE-backed rate peg requires a growing central-bank footprint and accelerating capital depletion, until financing costs rise sharply. Under certain parameters, large-scale QE makes previously sustainable debt levels unsustainable, leading ultimately to sovereign default.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，量化宽松（QE）会恶化政府债务可持续性。在我们的模型中，政府存在负的初级财政余额和向下倾斜的债务需求曲线，这使得利率具有内生性。央行持有长期资本，并将利润上缴给财政部门。量化宽松消耗了这部分资本存量，减少了未来的上缴利润和应对危机的储备。与Sargent和Wallace（1981）的结论——即更大的货币宽松程度会降低稳态债务水平——相反，我们证明量化宽松提高了稳态债务水平，并将违约边界向内推移，从而加剧了脆弱性并降低了债务可持续性。此外，尽管量化宽松能在较长时间内维持低利率，但维持量化宽松支撑的利率盯住政策需要央行资产负债表持续扩张和资本加速消耗，直至融资成本急剧上升。在特定参数条件下，大规模量化宽松会使原本可持续的债务水平变得不可持续，最终导致主权违约。
title: Quantitative Easing and Government Debt Sustainability
title_zh: 量化宽松与政府债务可持续性

abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
abstract_zh: 环境决策常影响健康，但疾病负担的估值仍面临挑战。当前的成本-疾病法（COI）和质量调整生命年等指标未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种跨健康状况评估疾病负担的新框架，通过广泛可用的偏好权重和已知支付意愿的基准健康状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中健康状态被低估。敏感性分析揭示了与统计生命价值一致的变异特征，凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将疾病负担纳入环境政策分析提供了实用工具。
title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架

abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。
title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失

abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.
abstract_zh: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担风险？我们通过考察投资者对合格小型企业股票（QSBS）计划变化的反应来探讨这一问题，该计划降低了初创企业投资的资本利得税。我们在一个框架下进行分析，其中部分初创企业投资者——风险投资家（VC）——将外部资金与基于激励的薪酬相结合，而其他投资者则使用自有资金。利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求，我们采用聚束分析、三重差分和匹配设计，对二十年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据进行分析。我们识别出策略性投资时机，即补贴促使投资者在符合税收优惠的持有期阈值处出现聚束现象。最值得注意的是，在税收补贴适用时，风险投资家将项目选择转向风险更高的企业：他们更多投资于商业化前阶段的初创企业，更可能为初创企业提供初始资本，并更多投资于已有债务的初创企业，同时减少联合投资。获得税收补贴的风险投资支持企业失败率更高，但另一方面，它们在退出时获得更高估值，且更可能达到"独角兽地位"。在面临相同税收补贴的可比非风险投资投资者中，未观察到这些模式。我们的进一步检验表明，税收激励导致资源向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更具影响力的专利。本研究首次证明，税收政策可将创业融资转向风险更高、更具创新性和价值的初创企业。
title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
title_zh: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据

abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th 2025 – affects emergency medical service (EMS) response performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City's congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design applied to approximately 1.6 million EMS incidents, we find that the January 2025 implementation of congestion pricing reduced passenger vehicle traffic by roughly 21 percent near the boundary and improved total EMS travel times by 63–70 seconds, approximately 5–6 percent. Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：急救医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务响应绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界，并结合对约160万起急救医疗事件的双重断点回归设计，我们发现2025年1月实施的拥堵收费使边界附近乘用车交通量减少约21%，并将急救医疗总行程时间缩短63至70秒，降幅约为5%至6%。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域产生转移效应。纽约消防局同期发布的将患者送往最近医院的指令干扰了标准双重差分估计，但未影响我们基于边界的识别策略。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。
